title: W11800233 — Service Diagnostic mode entry
description: Three-button Service Diagnostic entry × 3 rounds within 8 seconds.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Washer in standby (plugged in, all LEDs off). Choose any three buttons and remember their order. Within 8 seconds: press and release button 1, then 2, then 3 — repeat that same 3-button sequence two more times (3 rounds total). Success: all HMI indicators illuminate 1 second then turn off; status LEDs blink twice if no saved fault codes. Key 1 = HMI Test; Key 2 = Automatic Test; Key 3 = Fault Code Display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and Release Key 1, Key 2, Key 3; Repeat this 3 button sequence 2 more times within 8 seconds.
